description: What it does chat.cx is a Chrome/Edge extension that puts ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Perplexity, and more side by side in one panel — the real sites, on your own accounts. No new signup, no proxy: it has no servers, and chats go straight from your browser to each provider.
